name: COISC head-only control-oriented sensitivity feasibility validation
motivation: Q1 75-step head-only probe preserved Tp 120s MAE within the predeclared 0.005 C margin and reduced Tp PLE/WSR without sensitivity collapse.
hypothesis: With the Vanilla-LSTM-MS encoder fixed, a short head-only COISC adaptation can reduce Tp pre-lag leakage and wrong-sign sensitivity while preserving prediction accuracy.

data_protocol.windows: real field windows only; 200s history, 10s sampling, 120s recursive rollout, seven outputs
data_protocol.selection_evaluation: one final evaluation after the fixed head-only steps; no threshold, lambda, or checkpoint tuning

comparisons.R0: Vanilla-LSTM-MS base checkpoint selected by the existing source-macro prediction-MAE rule, with no head adaptation
comparisons.COISC: the same per-seed R0 checkpoint followed by fixed head-only adaptation; encoder and all non-head parameters frozen

training.base_model: existing B4 Vanilla-LSTM-MS real-field-only training protocol, 300/400/500 steps, 90887 parameters
training.fit_sampler: existing source-balanced base sampler; no excitation sampler in this validation
training.loss: unchanged B4 stage-2 factual one-step plus recursive weighted Huber/adjacent/endpoint terms + fixed DBASR sensitivity loss

primary_endpoints.Tp_PSM_guard: PSM must be at least 20% of paired R0 PSM and at least 5*epsilon_sign
primary_endpoints.overall_pass: all three predeclared seeds satisfy every per-seed endpoint; report paired mean, median, and seed-level values without post-hoc rescue

secondary_endpoints.prediction: MAE/RMSE for all seven outputs at 10/30/60/90/120s
secondary_endpoints.distribution: source x horizon x output absolute-error improvement and degradation counts
secondary_endpoints.failure_source: T5 on UH dual-power 0-100% 60s source, reported as a prespecified diagnostic, not a selection criterion
secondary_endpoints.sensitivity: PLE/WSR/PSM for all outputs, with empty lag regions reported NA
secondary_endpoints.events: existing two selection UH event sanity checks after final checkpoint; no model selection

required_checks: same source split and normalization for R0/COISC
only head.* parameters have requires_grad=true during adaptation
non-head checkpoint tensors byte-identical before and after adaptation
all 18 selection sources present and finite

stop_rule: If the primary endpoints fail for any seed, report COISC feasibility failure and stop the sensitivity-regularization line; do not alter lambda, lag, epsilon, source inclusion, or checkpoint rule. If all pass, proceed to the next predeclared COISC validation stage without changing this protocol.
